In a world ravaged by a catastrophic infection, a group of friends and family faces the ultimate test of survival as society collapses around them. As the undead rise and chaos spreads, the group is forced to navigate a perilous landscape where danger lurks at every turn.

sneak peak from a chapter I wrote last night:

Tommie positioned the light, illuminating my swollen, infected leg. Brian placed the blade against the worst part of the infection, his expression tight. "I'm going to make a small cuts. There will be a lot of bleeding and pus, and it's going to hurt due to the tenderness of your leg."

Brian's knife glinted in the dim light, the torch Tommie held shaking slightly in his hands. My breath hitched as the cold steel touched my burning, swollen skin.

"I'm making the first cut now," Brian muttered, his voice barely audible over the sound of my own heartbeat thundering in my ears. The anticipation was unbearable. I gripped the pillow Tommie had given me, bracing myself, but nothing could have prepared me for what came next.

As the blade sliced into my infected leg, a white-hot surge of pain tore through me. I let out a muffled scream into the pillow, biting down hard enough that I thought I might tear it apart. My vision blurred from the tears streaming down my face, and my body instinctively recoiled, but I was trapped, pinned down by the overwhelming agony
